measurements.privacy:
Privacy and wallet support

Sessions stay only in this tab’s memory and end on expiry, reload or server restart. Private visit history stays on the world server, subject to the owner’s retention policy for inactive visitor records. Resident memory is separate. Login never pauses, resets or advances the simulation.

Only simulated MetaMask/Rabby-style providers were tested. Actual extensions and mobile devices are untested. Compatible injected EVM account wallets may work. Smart contract wallets, Coinbase Smart Wallet and WalletConnect are not supported by this signature verifier.
